Hero.title: Here when you need support
Hero.subtitle: Dzvin is a space for everyday self-support. Check in with your mood, write privately in your journal, or try a brief exercise when things feel overwhelming.

path.heading: Your pace, your support
path.mood: Notice your mood, stress and energy whenever you choose.
path.diary: Write down your thoughts in a personal journal.
path.support: Open a breathing or calming exercise without completing a questionnaire.
path.note: Dzvin supports self-care. It does not diagnose conditions or replace professional or emergency care.

interactivity.title: Mood check-ins
interactivity.subtitle: Briefly record your mood, stress, energy and focus to notice changes over time.

support.title: Personal journal
support.subtitle: Write what is on your mind and revisit your entries in your history.

ai.title: Practical next steps
ai.subtitle: Find short exercises in the existing guide. Suggestions are not a diagnosis or a forecast.

Services.title:
Small moments of self-care
every day

intro.text: You don't need to analyze everything. Sometimes naming how you feel, writing it down or taking a short pause is enough for now.

predictionEngine.title: Your history
predictionEngine.text: Look back at your own mood check-ins and notice changes over time, without scores or competition.

scenarioSimulation.title: Breathing and calming
scenarioSimulation.text: Choose a simple exercise from the guide when you want to ease tension.

cohortEvidence.title: A space to write
cohortEvidence.text: Keep thoughts in your journal and return to them whenever you're ready.

steps.register: Sign in — create a personal space for your entries.
steps.choose: Choose what helps — check in, write in your journal or try an exercise.
steps.receive: Come back when useful — review your history and choose one manageable next step.

ReduceStress.title: Support on your terms
ReduceStress.subtitle: A short pause or journal entry can be a useful step. You decide what feels right today.
